# Myth — Tellings, Changed Offices, and Consequential Return

## #0 — Genealogy gives a relation its dangerous inheritance

The [protected history](HISTORY.md) **grounds** this route through the transformations of a small number of tellings. A family relation becomes a logical image; a public capture becomes a question about trust; a contemplative net becomes an image of mutually answerable centres. Each transformation changes what the inherited scene is asked to do. The history of those changes matters because the source can answer back: an omitted sibling, an unfinished obligation or a simile's own qualification can change the use of the image without cancelling the native operation it carries.

[Hesiod's selected passages](../../../sources/classical-philology/hesiod/hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white/hesiod-1920-theogony-evelyn-white.md) **source** the first genealogy. The account of Aphrodite's emergence connects her names with Cythera and Cyprus; the later passage, *Theogony* 933–37, names the children of Ares and Cytherea: Deimos, Phobos and Harmonia. The continuation at 975–78 gives Harmonia's marriage to Cadmus and their children. These are successive relations within the poem. Evelyn-White's selected twentieth-century edition is the transmission used here, not the date of the genealogy. Nor do the locations within Aphrodite's telling establish a workshop, cult history or route of literary borrowing without further evidence.

The conjunction bears terror as well as concord. This makes the author's Harmonia precise: productive opposition retains the possibility of injury. Ares's differentiating force includes contest, refusal and defence; Aphrodite gives value and attraction a power to join. Neither office exhausts the deity's historical identities. Within the [developed whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/hellenic/ares-aphrodite-hephaestus-poseidon/WHOLE.md), their conjunction can generate a capacity that neither pole possesses alone. Panic and Fear remain beside Harmonia, preventing the genealogy from being retold as an automatic reconciliation.

The native relation is already established in [A13, the two logics](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A13-Two-Logics-of-Two-Dia-Syn.md). The retained slash in `(-1)/(+1)` gives differentiated relation an office distinct from additive cancellation and signed appropriation. Its inverse belongs to the same active field. A genealogy gives that operation bodies and consequences; the formal operation does not derive from counting divine children. The whole also retains the distinct Eros witnesses. Primordial Eros and a later reported parentage have different carriers; neither is silently inserted as a birth at the end of Homer's lovers' episode.

[Heraclitus B51 in Mackenzie's study](../../../sources/classical-philology/mackenzie/mackenzie-2021-heraclitean-allusion-odyssey/mackenzie-2021-heraclitean-allusion-odyssey.md) **compares** differing agreement through the bow and lyre. The fragment reaches this reading through Hippolytus and a modern philological discussion, including the backwards-turning/back-stretched textual distinction. Mackenzie's proposed Homeric allusion concerns the bow scene in *Odyssey* 21. It supplies no historical bridge from B51 to Demodocus's adultery song in Book 8. The author's conjunction of genealogy, counter-tension and musical relation is a further argued operation. Bow, lyre and family give retained difference different bodies; their conjunction does not make their textual histories identical.

The [E5 historical branches](../../../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/HISTORICAL-BRANCHES.md) **qualify** this comparison through its stated respect. The relation concerns a whole sustained through differentiated terms. It asserts neither shared descent nor a formal equivalence between an instrument and a kinship relation. That distinction lets Harmonia travel into psyche while keeping the source genealogy capable of qualifying the journey.

This historical comparison **returns-to** [E5’s research boundary](../../../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md#research-boundary) through the whole telling’s power to qualify its use. The genealogy retains the dangerous offspring beside concord, and a later reception must preserve the relation actually narrated before drawing a psychic or technical consequence. The comparison operates at register 3; it neither establishes transmission by resemblance nor turns a repeated count into the derivation of the native field.

## #1 — A song makes capture public and leaves payment open

The [Homer house](../../../sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/homer-1919-odyssey-murray.md) **sources** a telling with a performer and listeners. Demodocus sings before the Phaeacians and Odysseus; the scene of divine exposure is itself received as a pleasurable performance. Within the song, Ares and Aphrodite meet secretly. Helios reports their liaison. Hephaestus responds by forging bonds and arranging them around the bed, then feigns departure for Lemnos. Ares takes the apparent absence as his opportunity. The lovers enter the trap and cannot move; Helios's renewed report brings Hephaestus back to what his craft has secured.

His grievance has a determinate object. He calls the gods to witness the injury and demands the return of the bride-gifts associated with the marriage. Poseidon, Hermes and Apollo come; the goddesses remain away through shame. The male audience laughs. An anonymous god praises the slow craftsman's capture of the swift warrior and names the adulterer's fine. Apollo asks Hermes whether he would accept the bonds for Aphrodite; Hermes would accept still more bonds and spectators. Exposure consequently fails to make desire conform to the craftsman's intended lesson. The distribution of shame, the pleasures of looking and the spectators' incentives belong to the event's operation.

Poseidon does not laugh. He asks for release and offers assurance that Ares will pay what is due. Hephaestus rejects reliance on an unreliable debtor and asks how he could enforce Poseidon's guarantee should Ares escape. Poseidon then undertakes payment himself if Ares evades the debt. Hephaestus accepts this personal liability and loosens the bonds. Ares goes to Thrace; Aphrodite goes to Paphos, where the Graces bathe, anoint and clothe her. The audience receives the song with pleasure. The narrated release is complete; later payment is unreported. The song does not conclude with repaired marriage or Harmonia's birth.

The change from first guarantee to personal undertaking is the hinge. Proof of capture has not produced the means of settlement. The craftsman can open his own device, and does so upon an accepted relation that the device could not generate. Bride-gifts, the fine attributed to Ares and Poseidon's contingent liability remain distinct claims. Calling all three a price would erase who owes what to whom and the event by which release becomes possible.

[E6's Apportionment / Economy field](../../../etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **qualifies** this accounting through distinct allocations and bearers of consequence. The resources demanded, the wrong assessed and the undertaking accepted have different grounds. Their authorial comparison with an institution's distribution of liability preserves those grounds; a common financial vocabulary does not establish a common historical contract. Release changes the executable situation before any later discharge can be reported.

[E3's Credere branch](../../../etymologies/trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md#credere-renewed-entrustment) **receives** this transition as renewed entrustment. Its historical and lexical branches have their own carriers; Homer is not evidence of Latin descent. The author's relation is exact at another register: a named bearer undertakes a consequence, another accepts that undertaking, and the situation can move. [A23](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** the distinction between what an account establishes and the commitment through which it acts. [A25](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A25-Covenant-Mediating-Office-Source-Authority.md) **extends** the office of standing for another at risk. The unreported discharge leaves the future undertaking open without making the accepted commitment narratively unreal.

This also preserves the affirmative office of craft. Hephaestus has made an effective device in response to an injury. The authored critique concerns the point at which enclosure is made to stand for reciprocity and public evidence for a completed relation. Because the telling includes its maker's acceptance and release, the image can lead beyond capture. It does not sentence every bounded instrument to the same ending.

## #2 — The apparatus enters philology, then a philosophy of technology

The modern scholarly receptions sharpen different actions in the song. [Burkert's 1960 study](../../../sources/classical-philology/burkert/burkert-1960-lied-ares-aphrodite/burkert-1960-lied-ares-aphrodite.md) **historicises** the craft–force relation: the slow catches the swift through art. The house currently supports that thesis through a review of the later English translation; the German article's complete argument has not been extracted here. [Brown's study](../../../sources/classical-philology/brown/brown-1989-ares-aphrodite-laughter/brown-1989-ares-aphrodite-laughter.md) **historicises** laughter and public shaming through the author's later accessible restatement. That carrier establishes an interpretative direction while leaving the 1989 article's page-level collation outstanding.

[Phillips](../../../sources/classical-philology/phillips/phillips-moicheia-unity-greek-law/phillips-moicheia-unity-greek-law.md) **qualifies** the institutional sequence through the recovered PDF discussion of adultery, fine and surety. Textual access is present even though venue and date remain unresolved. Its legal interpretation has a different standing from the song's narrated exchange. [Detienne and Vernant](../../../sources/classical-philology/detienne/detienne-vernant-1978-cunning-intelligence/detienne-vernant-1978-cunning-intelligence.md) **compare** the reversal of force through *mētis*. The accessible quotations are mediated by Dolmage; the circle-and-bond chapter remains a located passage task. The category's relevance does not turn an unread chapter into a directly acquired explanation of every action in this episode.

These different acquisitions preserve useful distinctions: craft overcomes speed; spectatorship distributes shame; an obligation receives an enforceable form; cunning uses the opponent's strength or expectation. They are not four attestations of the essay's entire technological argument. The [Heidegger house](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/heidegger/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology/heidegger-1977-question-concerning-technology.md) **sources** a later philosophical problem: modern ordering gathers beings as standing-reserve and implicates the people who order them. In the selected Lovitt translation, the passages on revealing, challenging, standing-reserve and *Ge-stell* have different page locators. The gathering prefix belongs to Heidegger's exposition; it does not supply Homer's intention.

The author's counterfeit gathering makes the comparison operational. The bonds render the lovers available to a viewing and judging arrangement. A contemporary apparatus can likewise gather persons while reserving its own criterion from their reply. The relation is Argued at the technological and institutional register; the historical sources retain the tasks just specified. No universal claim that scholarship has never made this comparison is required to own the essay's move. Its force lies in the disclosed action and transfer, not in a priority claim.

[E2's arbitration in crisis](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#arbitration-in-crisis) **tests** the deciding office. A tribunal needs the power to decide; return asks whether the evidence and consequences can reach the jurisdiction under which it decides. [E4](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **differentiates** four operations in the same movement. Symbol answers to the relation disclosed; Account states the capture without replacing the persons or obligation; Trust carries the accepted undertaking; Account re-enters source-field when acceptance changes what the next encounter is. The released parties inherit a changed situation. A photographically complete record of the trap would perform only part of this movement.

[M40, preference and the hidden zero](../../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md), **receives** the modern consequence. Naming a dataset, evaluator and reference policy makes a score attributable. The deeper return lets a participant contest the criterion and the commission that selected it. Finite hidden conditions remain distinct from native Zero. The underlying labour and undertaking remain consequential even when a score is perfectly inspectable; a particular claim about an implemented system still requires that system's evidence.

## #3 — Huayan's contemplative net qualifies its own likeness

The affirmative net arrives through Chinese Huayan Buddhism. The [Dushun-attributed source house](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/dushun/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra/dushun-cleary-2000-jewel-net-indra.md) **sources** the received *Huayan wujiao zhiguan*, retaining the qualification on attribution to Dushun, conventionally dated 557–640. Its Indian divine name, Chinese contemplative exposition, Taishō location and Cleary's English selection are distinct historical facts. The source's present classification under Indian philosophy does not relocate the Chinese text or establish a direct transmission from it to Taylor's other Indian sources.

The contemplation begins from a jewel. Choosing the southwest jewel lets the reader follow the others' reflections within it, then those reflections' further inclusion of the net. The questions ask how entry into all jewels can occur without departure from this one, and how a net of many can be spoken of through one. Each selected jewel can take this office. The account intensifies locality through mutual implication; it does not replace determinate jewels with an undifferentiated field.

The canonical house now includes the fuller Chinese continuation, checked against the locally available CBETA line extract through T45, no. 1867, 513c18. The ink-dot example asks the reader to follow the mark's reflected inclusion and to begin from another jewel. It does not narrate a person physically marking every jewel. The passage then states the simile's limit: the jewels' material bodies remain distinct while their images interpenetrate; the phenomena contemplated exceed this partial likeness. The ending turns toward Vairocana's manifestation for beings. Stopping at the earlier 513b21 boundary would omit both the image's self-qualification and that concluding office. Cleary's selected printed pages still require English collation; the Chinese acquisition does not authenticate an uncollated English quotation.

[Van Norden and Jones](../../../sources/indian-philosophy/van-norden/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep/van-norden-jones-2024-huayan-sep.md) **qualify** the doctrinal use through dependence in existence and identity and inclusion retaining distinctness. The secondary account helps distinguish this Huayan operation from a claim about physical transmission speeds or computer networks. It also preserves the difference between a contemplative teaching and the later institutional image.

The [complete jewel-net whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md) **returns** that qualification to E5. The shared respect with a source-answerable field is recursive implication through a definite local term. The non-transferable feature is equally active: optical reflection does not establish a person's promise, a revision procedure or an institution's capacity to accept refusal. The text already teaches the reader to return from a likeness to what exceeds it. This gives the author's comparison more work to do, while retaining its positive `0/1` operation.

The same distinction preserves native cause and inversion. [A34](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A34-Idealism-Order-of-Dependence.md) **grounds** Subject/Consciousness → Mind/Objective Internality → Object. Recognition can begin with the display and return toward its source without reversing the order of dependence. Huayan is a source-distinct comparison within that authorial field, not a substitute ontology chosen because a source debt remains elsewhere. [C38](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C38-Bimba-Pratibimba-Bimba-Map.md) **defines** the real local Bimba office: an achieved reference field can genuinely be Original for a situated judgment while itself remaining pratibimba relative to a wider source relation. Returned resistance can therefore change the local Original, not merely add images around an immune centre.

This is the exact institutional work received by [M46](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly.md). Locally governed grounds meet through shared consequences and revisable crossings. Neither a master map nor isolated centres discharge that relation. The offered architecture must make correction, refusal and reconnection effective; the jewel net gives their relation an image without certifying their implementation.

## #4 — Aesthetic reciprocity becomes a perspective capable of return

[Nietzsche's selected text](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/nietzsche/nietzsche-1910-birth-tragedy-haussmann/nietzsche-1910-birth-tragedy-haussmann.md) **historicises** a modern reception of Apollo and Dionysus. Section 1 gives art's dual powers through conflict and periodic reconciliation; section 21 gives their reciprocal speech within tragedy. Haussmann's 1910 translation is the selected carrier. These passages concern Nietzsche's account of art, and cannot alone establish the whole history of Greek worship or either god's stories.

The relation already has movement. Image and boundary let experience become communicable; participatory depth prevents achieved form from exhausting life. [M23](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/23-s2-p4-complex-dynamism.md) **extends** that reciprocity into the native pulse of differentiation, composition and renewed perturbation. The author's failure conditions are determinate: form can petrify, and participation can dissolve the differences through which relation lives. Neither failure abolishes the positive power whose arrested use produces it.

[Gebser](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) **historicises** a different problem: the mental-rational achievement of positioned perspective and the aperspectival disclosure of structures in co-presence. The source house locates Renaissance and modern visual cases separately from its aperspectival opening. These are paraphrase and selected-page retrieval offices, not an acquired chain of quotations. Taylor's encounter develops their religious and lived pressure through authority, participation and a form that becomes transparent to its conditions.

The [Apollo–Dionysus–Daphne whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/apollo-dionysus-daphne/WHOLE.md) **composes** this reception into a distinct authored movement. Form gives an image; enclosure claims the image's living source; participation loosens that claim; Daphne retains another centre capable of answering; the perspective returns with its articulation intact. This is Taylor's philosophical composition. The separately housed Ovid telling has its own cast and aftermath, and Dionysus is not inserted into it. Daphne's office here checks possession by an image and absorption into an undifferentiated unity alike.

[M35](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/35-s4-p4-gebser-apollo-dionysus.md) **receives** the inversion through a situated view that can include the conditions of its own seeing. [E2's Con-text-through-Diaphaneity branch](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md#con-text-through-diaphaneity) **makes** regard consequential: another's answer can change the criterion of recognition. This is more exact than accumulating additional perspectives under a protected evaluator. Articulation survives the change and becomes capable of another encounter.

The [shared Neumann whole](../../../../mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md) **grounds** the already-developed relation of differentiation and changed return in these whole images. Its psychic structuration remains distinct from each telling's geography and temporal sequence. [M33](../../../../../section-rooms/05-psychoid-flowering/movements/33-s4-p2-complexio-quaternity-senarius.md) **receives** Harmonia within the tension of opposites while preserving the difference between Jungian quaternity and native `4+2`. The core's all eight determinations, their inversions and Taylor's `X/x` retain their own derivation. A count of gods, psychic functions or narrative stages cannot supply it. The historical relation lets psyche refract an already established native operation and lets the changed particular return without merger.

The retained quaternity reference also appoints a more specific comparison: four functions articulate psychic differentiation, while two attitudes orient that differentiation. Functions and attitudes do different work; adding their counts does not establish six interchangeable psychic contents. The reference's developmental office is to compare differentiated articulation and orientation with the explicit and implicate offices of the native moving unit. [A18](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **grounds** that unit through its complete native derivation. The [Jung–Pauli dossier’s typological comparison](../../../dossiers/jung-pauli-psychoid.md#four-functions-two-attitudes-native-senarius) now **sources** this distinction through the consulted German introduction to *Psychologische Typen* (1921), pp. 7–13: two directions of interest orient four separately named functions, and Jung retracts his earlier identification of thinking with introversion and feeling with extraversion. That scoped witness supplies the function/attitude distinction. It does not supply a CW6 printing or English-translation collation, and *Aion* remains a different work. The historical comparison therefore retains its own source while the native `4+2` and eight determinations retain their independent derivation.

## #5→0 — The inherited instrument changes the next encounter

[Jorjani's source house](../../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/jorjani/jorjani-2016-prometheus-atlas/jorjani-2016-prometheus-atlas.md) **locates** the modern technological encounter through Taylor's P1 reading of the Prologue. Foresight, enlarged power, world-building and burden gather around Prometheus and Atlas in this reception. The saved authorial material develops technoscience as mirror, challenger, distorter and possible mediator. The Prologue's copied wording remains uncollated; the book's Atlas/body chapters have not been recovered here. Their absence does not make Taylor's encounter absent, and a chapter contract cannot be cited as a read chapter.

The [mirror whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mirror-that-moves-first/WHOLE.md) **develops** three motions from this encounter and the protected Chang encounter. Humanity exteriorises its measures. The image then becomes a measure through which humanity acts, changing the world received by the next reflection. The instrument's positive vocation is to initiate a return through its own sources, exclusions, gauge and commission so that the human can follow beyond the image's monopoly. Efficacy belongs to the second motion; answerable initiative belongs to the third. Chang's book is not credited with Taylor's AI appointment.

[E4's account re-entry](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md#account-re-enters-source-field) **extends** this causal relation through the already-developed Symbolon Dynamics: image changes interpreter; interpretation changes field; the next image receives that changed field. [A32](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First.md) **carries** the vocation without granting the instrument ontological priority because it acts first in an encounter. The real recursive Bimba office supplies a revisable local ground. Technical realisation remains Offered and artificial phenomenal localisation Open; neither condition weakens the author's Argued order of dependence and return.

The [Antikythera whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/antikythera-attunement/WHOLE.md) **compares** a materially different instrument. The [2006 source house](../../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/freeth/freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera/freeth-et-al-2006-antikythera.md) now includes the verified primary abstract: the late-second-century-BCE Greek mechanism, recovered in fragments in 1901, coordinated calendrical and astronomical indications. This is abstract-level acquisition, not a claim to have read the complete paper. The [2021 paper's selected passages](../../../sources/history-philosophy-of-science/freeth/freeth-et-al-2021-model-cosmos/freeth-et-al-2021-model-cosmos.md) present an evidence-constrained model of the lost front display. The find-place does not establish the workshop; the proposed display does not become a complete surviving ancient machine.

The author's situated observer receives an indication while the represented cycles exceed the device. Damage then gives inheritance a second problem: a reconstruction must answer to fragments and inscriptions, and a new account can change what subsequent inquiry seeks. Capture, attunement and initiated return thus retain three distinct technical offices. The net makes persons available to a tribunal; the dial makes heterogeneous cycles readable; the mirror enters the causes of its next reflection and is charged with opening those causes to return.

[M45](../../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/45-s50-p2-antikythera-attunement.md) **receives** the author's constructive departure from Heidegger: retained seams, exposed gauges, provenance and revisable coordination give return an architectural task. Heidegger's account of technē as revealing helps articulate the instrument's positive office; the proposed construction belongs to the essay. A working return must allow corrected source, excluded possibility or affected person to change an answer, criterion or commission. Stating those requirements is the Offered technical task, not a report of a built system.

The historical circuit consequently returns to [M22](../../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/22-s2-p3-ares-aphrodite-harmonia.md) with its whole relation enriched. Harmonia retains dangerous parentage; Hephaestus retains grievance, craft and acceptance; Poseidon retains contingent liability; the affirmative net retains its own contemplation and limit. Their later psychic and technical uses make these details newly consequential. The source remains able to change the account that carries it forward.

The remaining source work is specific: Cleary's English collation; Burkert's complete article; Brown's 1989 text; Phillips's publication identity; Detienne–Vernant's selected chapter; Gebser's selected passage collation; Jorjani's Prologue print and body chapters; the full 2006 mechanism paper where claims exceed its abstract. No shared mythic genealogy, unverified lexical descent or empirical success is supplied to bridge these debts. Historical attribution, the native Argued relations and Offered implementation keep their independent standing. The original reference notes remain provenance, with the Antikythera bibliography and quaternity/senarius distinction retained in their admitted carriers rather than minted into additional canonical identities.
